Q1: This CI failure is inherited from the base branch, and open PR #9246 already owns the fix. What should this issue deliver?
Choices:
A) Change no code. Mark this issue as tracked by PR #9246. After #9246 merges, bring `ai/issue-9256` (PR #9277) up to date with the base branch and re-run CI. Do not skip or loosen the test. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Fix it on this branch with a test-only change in `tests/test_gh_retry_stdout_isolation.py`. Keep the assertion strict (one call, non-zero `PIPESTATUS[0]`), but pipe into a reader that really closes its input on every runner instead of `head -c 1`. Leave `gh_retry` unchanged. **Note:** this edits the same test as open PR #9246 and will probably conflict with it or duplicate it.
C) Fix it in `gh_retry` (`scripts/gh_helpers.sh`) so it reports a non-zero status even when the reader reads everything. **Note:** the diagnostics show the output was fully delivered in this case, so this changes behaviour that is currently correct. It also overlaps with #9246 and with open PR #9283, which touches `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`.
